Registration (eApply)
How can I register for the doctorate?
If you fulfill the admission requirements, have the Download confirmation (PDF, 517 KB) by a professor at ETH to act as the supervisor of your doctoral thesis, and have collected all of the required registration documents, register for the doctorate online via eApply.
You will be guided through the online registration procedure step by step. Note that your entries must be substantiated by uploads of the required documents (CV, official academic records, etc.). To complete your registration you will be directed automatically to the payments page for the payment of the application fee. You will receive a confirmation by email as soon as you submit your online registration.
If anything is unclear during registration, please consult the help button at the top right of the page you are currently on. There you will find detailed information and explanations on the topic of the page in question.
